name: Acme_HelloView
author: Acme (example)
description: Reference declarative-view plugin (DV-6): a tab view (section, list, button), a detail view reached by open (stat, badge, destructive button) and a static about view from layout/about.json. Daemon half only; see docs/wiki/declarative-views.md.

tools.name: acme_helloview_mark
tools.description: Marks an item as done (or adds a new one when no id is given), then tells clients the main view changed.
